scope: 64 fresh pages per runtime; actual public Liberation 2.1.5 bytes, generic serif/sans-serif and named Liberation Mono profile, actual static regular/bold/italic faces, normal line metrics, positive/negative letter spacing, font registry removal and size mutation. Chromium generic monospace is host-dependent; this comparator selects the same named public Mono face. Supplemental contracts, not original WPT.

fullGate.note: The initial combined check exposed six obsolete internal expectations after implementing real default-font text and computed order. Those cases were corrected to validate supported behavior or genuinely unsupported mixed/preformatted text, without changing original WPT assertions. The complete Bun suite and all remaining native check components passed separately.

limitations: Single bounded LTR Latin run; mixed inline layout, anonymous flex/grid text, generated text boxes, bidi, glyph fallback and painting remain unsupported.
Default Canvas fonts remain unsupported; loaded normal matching faces are required for canvas widths.
Variable fonts, oblique synthesis, non-normal stretch and non-default shaping descriptors remain unsupported.
Generic system-ui is a deterministic public Sans profile, not every host platform font.
These checks do not prove private integration or full SPA compatibility; no new performance measurement.
